758:t_1:839.en:
$$正太郎$$
「If $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ work together, we won't lose to the $$ロボットマフィア$$.」

758:t_1:840.en:
$$マッキー$$
「...All right, $$正太郎$$. Make sure you're back before the ceremony.」

758:t_1:842.en:
$$敷島$$
「Maintenance on $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ is complete. They're ready to leave at any time.」

758:t_1:843.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Thank you, Doctor. I'll be going, then.」

758:t_1:844.en:
$$正太郎$$
(Let's go, $$鉄人$$... You're the Messenger of the Sun who protects justice.)

758:t_1:845.en:
$$正太郎$$
(I'll keep fighting alongside you, until the day evil truly vanishes from this world...)

758:t_1:846.en:
$$正太郎$$
(And someday, let's go see everyone, bringing peace as our gift.)

758:t_1:850.en:
$$大塚$$
「...Everyone in the $$クラッシャー隊$$, you're ready to depart, aren't you?」

758:t_1:852.en:
$$ナオト$$
「The $$クラッシャー隊$$'s new mission... I can't wait to get started.」

758:t_1:853.en:
$$アキラ$$
「We're surveying the Solar System reborn as a hyperdimensional world... This mission looks like it'll take a long time.」

758:t_1:854.en:
$$ナミダ$$
「Leave the $$クラッシャー隊$$'s base to me while you're away.」

758:t_1:856.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「You've been accepted as a trainee member now, $$ナミダ$$. We'll be relying on you from now on.」

758:t_1:857.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm sure Earth will be interacting with all sorts of planets by the time you're a full member, $$ナミダ$$.」

758:t_1:858.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「To prepare for that, I'll return to the $$ギシン星$$ system for a while and coordinate each planet's wishes.」

758:t_1:861.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait for me, $$ロゼ$$. Once we've finished surveying the Solar System, I'm planning to go to $$ギシン星$$ too.」

758:t_1:862.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll visit the planet where I was born with $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and renew my vow to peace there.」

758:t_1:866.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$マーズ$$... I'll join you on that journey.」

758:t_1:867.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「I'll do it so I can protect this peace alongside you.」

758:t_1:869.en:
$$タケル$$
(And thank you, Brother... You'll be with me forever...)

758:t_1:870.en:
$$タケル$$
(Let's protect this universe's love and peace together... That's the battle I'll fight from now on.)

758:t_1:874.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...Still, I never thought all of us would end up working for $$プリベンター$$.」

758:t_1:875.en:
$$カトル$$
「War is over, but we need to prepare for what may happen from now on.」

758:t_1:876.en:
$$トロワ$$
「If we want to put the $$ガンダム$$s to the best use, this is the only place.」

758:t_1:877.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Well... I can understand the rest of us, but I didn't expect even $$ヒイロ$$ and $$五飛$$ to agree.」

758:t_1:878.en:
$$五飛$$
「Now that I know how strong we can be by uniting our power, there's no need for needless stubbornness.」

758:t_1:880.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...It's almost time to depart. That's enough idle chatter.」

758:t_1:881.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Guarding the gate when it activates... So that's our first mission.」

758:t_1:882.en:
$$カトル$$
「It looks like the people seeing us off have arrived.」

758:t_1:884.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't worry. Compared with the center of the galaxy, it's practically next door.」

758:t_1:885.en:
$$キャスリン$$
「I'll be waiting for you to come home safely, $$トロワ$$.」

758:t_1:886.en:
$$トロワ$$
「I'll be back before the next performance. Tell the Ringmaster that too.」

758:t_1:887.en:
$$サリィ$$
「That $$プリベンター$$ jacket suits you, $$五飛$$.」

758:t_1:888.en:
$$五飛$$
「This is the justice I've found.」

758:t_1:889.en:
$$ドロシー#pt101$$
「I wonder how long the peace you $$ガンダム$$ pilots won back for us will last.」

758:t_1:890.en:
$$カトル$$
「It will take the efforts of everyone living in this world to keep it going.」

758:t_1:891.en:
$$マリーメイア$$
「I'll take those words to heart.」

758:t_1:893.en:
$$レディ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$... You have a visitor too.」

758:t_1:896.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It wasn't easy to find a gap in $$リリーナ$$'s official duties.」

758:t_1:897.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I took the liberty of doing one last favor as your brother.」

758:t_1:900.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「...It's strange. I had so much I wanted to say, but now that we're face to face, I can't find the words.」

758:t_1:902.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...It's time. We'll talk another time.」

758:t_1:903.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Yes. Please make sure you come home.」

758:t_1:907.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That's probably how $$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$ do things.」

758:t_1:909.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Then let's go. I'll take command at our destination.」

758:t_1:911.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(I'll be going, $$リリーナ$$. Protect the peace of this world...)

758:t_1:912.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(If anyone stands in your way, I'll eliminate them... Even at the cost of my life...)

758:t_1:916.en:
$$マリナ$$
(This flower... is proof that $$刹那$$ and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ connected their hearts...)

758:t_1:917.en:
$$クラウス$$
「What do you think, Princess $$マリナ$$? How does it feel to finally see the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ flower up close?」

758:t_1:918.en:
$$マリナ$$
「There are things I cannot put into words.」

758:t_1:919.en:
$$マリナ$$
「But I can feel the wishes of those who fought for peace in that flower.」

758:t_1:920.en:
$$シーリン$$
「I'm sorry to interrupt your reflections, but you have a visitor.」

758:t_1:922.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$マリナ・イスマイール$$...」

758:t_1:924.en:
$$刹那$$
「I've finally gotten to see you...」

758:t_1:925.en:
$$マリナ$$
「Yes... But I believed we would meet someday.」

758:t_1:926.en:
$$刹那$$
「Because we're seeking the same thing...」

758:t_1:927.en:
$$刹那$$
「After all that fighting, I understand... You were right to reject fighting.」
